note: Export activity is confirmed by dated Indian customs records with destination, HS code and BOL numbers (Kenya, Singapore, Philippines; 2025-01-31 to 2025-12-11), so the company is a real, shipping exporter — not merely a catalogue claim. Declared HS 840610 (steam/vapour turbines) is not the HS on the observed records: the visible rows are parts/accessories (84069000 turbine parts, 84836010 flexible coupling, 85044090 SMPS, 68151900 gaskets), i.e. the company ships turbine spares and components alongside complete units; per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground — HS should be recorded as the actual codes seen (84069000 primary) with verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Domestic supply: only self-declared installation references on the company site; no GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP award or audited domestic revenue split is public in the sources reachable, so domestic_status is declared_only, not confirmed. Revenue and export value: null — ImportKey free view shows shipment counts (116) but no values, and no financials were accessible; not estimated. Role: manufacturer (site describes in-house turbine manufacture; customs rows show it as the Indian exporter/supplier).
